red_fitscube_update_keywords.pro

Routines

top source red_fitscube_update_keywords

SST pipeline

red_fitscube_update_keywords, filename [, /do_update] [, out_dir=string] [, /remove_original]

Update a fitscube for GaVO DaCHS if needed.

Parameters

filename in type=string

The file to update.

Keywords

do_update in optional type=boolean

Do the update even if the GaVO DaCHS keywords already seem to be there.

out_dir in optional type=string

Put the updated file here instead of in the original file's directory (default if /remove_original) or the local directory (default otherwise).

remove_original in optional type=boolean

Remove the original file.
